name: Malluch
overview: Malluch appears in Scripture as a notable figure among the post-exilic community, identified both as a Merarite Levite and a member of the family of Harim. He is mentioned alongside others who took decisive steps to uphold covenant purity by divorcing Gentile wives after the captivity, demonstrating a commitment to the holiness of God's people. Additionally, Malluch is recorded as a priest and a chief who actively participated in sealing the covenant with Nehemiah, highlighting his leadership role in the spiritual renewal and restoration of Israel.
